items.summary: 米国魚類野生生物局からEcosystems Connections Instituteへ$47,000の助成。ミシガン州ダンディーのリバーレーズン川にある低頭ダムでの魚道設置に向けた工学・水文・生物調査(実現可能性調査)に使われる。
items.verbatim: THERE ARE TWO FISH PASSAGEWAY ASSESSMENT PROJECTS ASSOCIATED WITH THIS INITIATIVE. THEFIRST IS A PROPOSED ENGINEERING BIOLOGICAL SURVEY FOR A FISH PASSAGEWAY AROUND THE LOWHEADDAM AT DUNDEE, MICHIGAN IN THE RIVER RAISIN. THIS PROJECT WILL FOCUS ON A DETAILEDSITE ENGINEERING SURVEY, A HYDROLOGIC SURV
REMOVAL OF THE PROVIDENCE LOW-HEAD DAM AND FISH PASSAGEWAY BARRIER IN SILVER CREEK, NEW ALBANY, INDIANA
